image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a Dungeness crab being held by a human hand. The crab is facing the camera, displaying its broad, oval carapace which is reddish-brown with lighter mottling. Two large, robust claws (chelipeds) are prominent in the foreground, showing cream-colored bases and dark tips. Several walking legs are visible extending laterally. The background includes a blurred human torso wearing a white t-shirt with partial text.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are stalked and protrude from anterior carapace margin.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two distinct, stalked eyes are clearly visible protruding from the front edge of the carapace, consistent with decapod anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Carapace is smooth and convex displaying purplish-brown to reddish-brown coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The carapace exhibits the characteristic reddish-brown hue and appears smooth and convex, matching the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is cream to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows the dorsal view of the crab; the ventral surface (abdomen/underside) is not visible as it is folded underneath or obscured by the holding hand.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Broad oval carapace of substantial edible-crab proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The carapace shape is distinctly broad and oval, fitting the 'substantial' proportions expected of a Dungeness crab.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Carapace displays lighter mottled patterns over purplish-brown base.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Lighter, irregular mottled patterns are visible on the reddish-brown carapace, particularly towards the posterior edges.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Exoskeleton is hard and calcified with smooth glossy texture.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Specular highlights on the carapace and claws indicate a smooth, glossy, hard exoskeleton typical of crustaceans.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five pairs of walking legs extend laterally.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While not all 10 legs are fully visible due to perspective and occlusion by the hand, multiple walking legs are seen extending laterally from the body, consistent with the five-pair structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: First pair modified into robust claws of unequal size with dark tips.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The two chelipeds are robust and clearly visible. They appear slightly asymmetrical (common in live crabs) and feature distinct dark coloring at the tips of the dactyls.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Claws have smooth outer surface and serrated inner edges.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The outer surfaces of the claws appear smooth. The inner edges (visible where the pincers meet) show the expected tooth-like serrations for gripping.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the white t-shirt in the background ('AEND...') is partially legible but distorted and nonsensical, a common artifact in AI-generated images involving text.

The skin texture on the fingers holding the crab appears slightly waxy and lacks fine pore detail, blending somewhat smoothly into the background, suggesting minor generation artifacts in non-primary subjects.
